job.job_description:
Job Description: Generative AI Engineer

Experience: 2+ Years

Shift Timings 12PM - 9PM

Monday to Friday

5Days Work from Office




Job Summary:

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer with experience in Python, LLMs, and AI application development to build and implement AI-powered solutions.




Key Responsibilities:

Develop Generative AI applications using Python and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build RAG-based applications, AI chatbots, and intelligent assistants.
Work with prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.
Use frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Integrate LLM APIs and develop REST APIs.
Test, troubleshoot, and optimize AI applications.

Required Skills:

Strong knowledge of Python.
Hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
Understanding of RAG, prompt engineering, and embeddings.
Familiarity with LangChain, vector databases, and REST APIs.
Knowledge of Git and cloud platforms is an advantage.
Good problem-solving and communication skills.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
